name: CSP Crawl Tier 3 — Apify WCC + Proxy

meta.description: Tier 3 site crawl: Apify Website Content Crawler with Apify proxy (~$0.004/page). Breaks Cloudflare and heavy bot detection. Best effort — always returns result regardless of quality. Multi-page support. Part of M74 three-tier crawl architecture.

parameters.body: ={{ JSON.stringify({ startUrls: [{ url: $json.website }], maxCrawlPages: $json.max_pages, proxyConfiguration: { useApifyProxy: true, apifyProxyGroups: ['RESIDENTIAL'] } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ vendor_website: $json.website, tier_used: 'tier3_wcc', pages: ($json.pages || []).map(p => ({ page_url: p.url || p.loadedUrl || '', title: p.title || '', clean_text: p.text || '', word_count: (p.text || '').split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).length, page_depth: p.depth || 1 })).filter(p => p.page_url) }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ vendor_website: $('Normalize Pages').first().json.website, column: 'crawl_tier3_result', payload: { ok: $('Normalize Pages').first().json.ok, pipeline: 'csp-crawl-tier3-wcc', crawled_at: new Date().toISOString(), pages_fetched: ($('Normalize Pages').first().json.pages || []).length, word_count: $('Normalize Pages').first().json.word_count, fields: { name: $('Normalize Pages').first().json.name } } }) }}
